snapshots.system: Two organizations after merger deal. Coupling phase.

confirming_events.Z1: Teams use shared terminology in working documents. Recorded in three joint reports.
confirming_events.Z2: Decisions are made by leadership of combined structure. Teams execute, do not initiate.
confirming_events.Z3: Joint strategic session held. Vision formulated but not shared by all.
confirming_events.Y1: Processes integrated formally. Protocol signed. Everyday practice unchanged.
confirming_events.Y2: Proposals of one team do not account for specifics of the other. Standard solutions.
confirming_events.Y3: No joint developments. No new formats emerged.
confirming_events.X1: Three joint working groups created. Channels exist.
confirming_events.X2: Interaction by protocol. Outside working groups, contacts minimal.
confirming_events.W1: Budgets consolidated, distribution through one center.
confirming_events.W2: Upon departure of key manager, process will stop.
confirming_events.W3: Integration contract signed for two years.

expected_diagnosis.priority_rationale: Quality is lagging axis. Not embedded. Until Y grows, system will not transition.

snapshots.system: City of 50k. Metallurgical factory provides 60% jobs, 40% budget.

confirming_events.Z1: Administration and factory use different terms. No joint documents.
confirming_events.Z2: Decisions by administration and factory. Residents execute, do not initiate.
confirming_events.Z3: Strategy written by administration. Not discussed with residents.
confirming_events.Y1: Projects on paper. Not in everyday life.
confirming_events.Y2: Projects do not account for residents' needs. Standard solutions.
confirming_events.Y3: No new formats. City reproduces existing.
confirming_events.X1: One channel: administration-factory. Other groups not connected.
confirming_events.X2: Interaction by protocol. Outside formal meetings, no contacts.
confirming_events.W1: All resources through factory. One channel.
confirming_events.W2: Upon production cuts, city will not withstand. No reserves.
confirming_events.W3: Factory funds social projects. Horizon one year.

expected_diagnosis.priority_rationale: Identity first. Without shared language, agency, vision — quality and connections cannot be built. Pattern Z→Y/X→W.

snapshots.system: Pre-seed startup. 3 founders, 2 developers. Digital platform.

confirming_events.Z1: Team uses shared terminology. Users understand interface without explanation.
confirming_events.Z2: Founders distribute tasks independently. Decisions joint.
confirming_events.Z3: Vision formulated. Team understands direction. Not discussed with users.
confirming_events.Y1: Product used by test group. Not embedded in everyday life.
confirming_events.Y2: Feedback collected but does not influence product.
confirming_events.Y3: One new format proposed by user. Not implemented.
confirming_events.X1: One channel: founders-test group. Other segments not covered.
confirming_events.X2: Interaction by testing protocol. Outside sessions, no contacts.
confirming_events.W1: No revenue. Product free. Investment single source.
confirming_events.W2: Upon cessation of investment, team will not survive.
confirming_events.W3: Investment for six months. Horizon one funding cycle.

expected_diagnosis.priority_rationale: Quality lagging. Product exists but not adapted. Feedback does not influence result. Until Y grows, W will not appear.

snapshots.system: Regional architecture firm. 9 people. Public buildings specialization.

confirming_events.Z1: Firm has recognizable style. Clients understand terminology. Language does not extend beyond firm.
confirming_events.Z2: Decisions by chief architect. Architects execute. Partners approve, do not initiate.
confirming_events.Z3: Vision by chief architect. Not discussed with team.
confirming_events.Y1: Projects realized. Built objects used. Firm present in urban environment.
confirming_events.Y2: Projects adapted to client needs. Customization exists. Hidden needs not accounted.
confirming_events.Y3: New formats by chief architect. Team does not generate.
confirming_events.X1: Three permanent clients. Connections with contractors. Conference participation.
confirming_events.X2: Clients consult at early stages. Exchange substantive. No joint decisions.
confirming_events.X3: Interaction regular. By project cycle. Stable.
confirming_events.W1: Three clients provide 70% revenue. Two new clients last year.
confirming_events.W2: Upon departure of chief architect, firm loses style and clients.
confirming_events.W3: Contracts 2-3 years. Joint planning with two of three clients.

expected_diagnosis.priority_rationale: Identity lagging. Agency concentrated in one person. Vision not shared. Until Z grows, Y and X will not transition to level 3.

snapshots.system: Regional party branch. 3 deputies out of 40. Opposition.

confirming_events.Z1: Party rhetoric recognizable. Members use shared terminology. Does not extend beyond activists.
confirming_events.Z2: Decisions by regional leadership. Local branches execute. Rank-and-file do not initiate.
confirming_events.Z3: Program by leadership. Not discussed with rank-and-file.
confirming_events.Y1: Party projects exist. Not embedded in voters' everyday life.
confirming_events.Y2: Program accounts for general needs. Not adapted to local communities.
confirming_events.Y3: No new formats. Standard rallies and leaflets.
confirming_events.X1: One channel: activists-voters in five cities. Other groups not covered.
confirming_events.X2: Interaction by protocol: rally, leaflet, voting. Between campaigns, silence.
confirming_events.W1: 3 deputies out of 40. 7.5% votes. One source: party list.
confirming_events.W2: Upon change of leader, party loses identity. Upon cessation of funding, ceases activity.
confirming_events.W3: Electoral support one-time. Horizon one election.

expected_diagnosis.priority_rationale: Identity first. Agency concentrated in leadership. Vision not shared. Language does not extend beyond activists. Pattern Z→Y/X→W.
